role: Gate: replays FeatureProbe cases (a feature config, position and Random seed) through the native feature table, checking per case the write count, every write, the 3x3 hash, tile entities when the manifest lists them, and the whole region at the end.

structs.name: te
structs.java: a tile entity's position, kind and canonical NBT

notes: Data: out/java/probes/* whose manifest kind is feature (Makefile DATA_feature = probes). Uses probe.h. The concrete WorldGen* classes covered depend on features_for's table (features.c, features_nether.c), not enumerated here. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
